records.target: Largest national vote share if held today
records.condition: If this election were held today
records.method: Unweighted mean of the latest poll per institute published within thirty days. Descriptive input to AI analysis; no calibrated win probabilities.
records.limitations: Conditional vote-share scenario. Not a prediction of seat control, coalition formation, or the eventual election-day result.
records.analysis: Multiple independent polls show the supplied leader ahead of the next party under the conditional today scenario.

records.race: South Dakota Class II · US Senate
records.method: Reported share above half, lead at least five percentage points, reporting estimate at least ninety-nine percent, fresh timestamp and official-source provenance for all candidate totals. AI may withhold an eligible call.
records.limitations: SDCofA projection based on reported returns via elekt. Reporting estimates and returns can change. This is not official certification.
records.analysis: Complete vote reporting shows the supplied leader with a decisive share advantage over the opponent.
